The Sahabah (RA)'s Suspicion about the Person who did not Perform the Fajr and Isha Salaahs in Congregation
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) says, "When we did not see a person for the Fajr and Isha salaahs, we became suspicious of him (because it is the Munaafiqeen who do not perform these salaahs)." [^2]
Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s Statement concerning a Person Who missed the Fajr Salaah in congregation because he had Stayed awake at Night In Ibaadah

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abu Bakr bin Sulaymaan bin Abu Hathma
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Bakr bin Sulaymaan bin Abu Hathma narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once did not see Hadhrat Sulaymaan bin Abu Hathma (RA) for the Fajr salaah. Hadhrat Umar (RA) was on his way to the marketplace that morning and because Hadhrat Sulaymaan (RA)'s house happened to be between the Masjid and the marketplace, Hadhrat Umar (RA) passed by Hadhrat Sulaymaan (RA)'s mother Hadhrat Shifaa (RA). "I did not see Sulaymaan for the Fajr salaah," Hadhrat Umar (RA) said. She explained, "He spent the night in salaah and sleep overpowered him." To this, Hadhrat Umar (RA) remarked, "I prefer attending the Fajr salaah in congregation to standing in salaah all night." [^3]

Hadhrat Ibn Abu Mulaykah (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Shifaa (RA) who belonged to the Banu Adi bin Ka'b tribe once came to Hadhrat Umar (RA) during Ramadhaan. Enquiring about her husband, Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "Why did I not see Abu Hathma for the Fajr salaah?" "O Ameerul Mu'mineen!" she explained, "He exerted himself (in Ibaadah) throughout the night and was too tired to go out to perform the Fajr salaah, so he (performed salaah at home and) slept." Hadhrat Umar (RA) remarked, "By Allaah! Had he been present for the Fajr salaah, it would have been more beloved to me than his exertion throughout the night."

In another narration, Hadhrat Shifaa bint Abdullaah (RA) says, "Hadhrat Umar (RA) once came to my house where he found two men (my husband and son) fast asleep. 'What is the matter with these two that they were not present with us for salaah?' he asked. 'O Ameerul Mu'mineen!' I explained, 'They fell asleep after performing their Fajr salaah (at home).' To this Hadhrat Umar (RA) remarked, 'I prefer performing Fajr salaah in congregation to performing (Nafl) salaah
